details: S&P Dow Jones Indices and Pantera Capital introduced a new digital asset index that ranks cryptocurrencies based on protocol revenue rather than just market capitalization. Solana (SOL) is prominently featured among the top five holdings, alongside Ether and BNB, while Bitcoin and XRP were excluded. This development signifies increasing institutional recognition of the underlying economic activity and utility of these blockchain networks.
title: S&P Dow Jones Indices Launches Protocol Revenue Index, Solana a Top Holding

details: Senate Republicans have released a comprehensive draft of the Clarity Act, a significant bill aimed at regulating the crypto industry in the U.S. While the bill is generally supported by the industry for providing much-needed regulatory certainty, Democrats are reportedly pushing for stronger ethics provisions concerning political figures' cryptocurrency holdings. This debate introduces some near-term uncertainty regarding the bill's final passage.
title: Clarity Act Progresses in Senate Amid Ethics Debate

details: Veteran cryptocurrency exchange BitMEX is slated to permanently cease operations, 11 years after its co-founder Arthur Hayes launched the platform. The reasons for the shutdown were not immediately detailed.
title: BitMEX Crypto Exchange Announces Permanent Shutdown

details: A security vulnerability in the Verus-Ethereum bridge has led to the draining of $7.5 million in a new attack. This exploit reportedly leveraged a flaw that was previously utilized in a similar incident in May, raising renewed concerns about cross-chain bridge security.
title: Verus-Ethereum Bridge Exploited for $7.5 Million

details: Global financial technology firm Circle has announced strategic partnerships with South Korean giants Kakao and Toss Bank. The collaboration aims to explore and develop stablecoin payment rails within South Korea, signaling growing integration of digital assets into mainstream financial services in the region.
title: Circle Partners with Kakao and Toss Bank for Stablecoin Payments in South Korea

details: Swiss bank BancaStato has launched trading services for Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and Solana (SOL) in collaboration with digital asset bank Sygnum. This move further highlights the increasing adoption of cryptocurrencies by traditional financial institutions, offering regulated access to digital assets for their clients.
title: Swiss Bank BancaStato Integrates Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana Trading

details: According to various sentiment indicators, including the Fear & Greed Index, the overall cryptocurrency market sentiment is currently neutral, hovering around a score of 50-55. This suggests a balance between fear and greed among investors, without a strong directional bias.
title: Crypto Market Sentiment Remains Neutral
